Basketball Free-Throw Shooter

The TV is the court. Your phone is your shooting hand — flick to shoot.

playing on your phone?

Host: open this page on the laptop or TV, start a match, and players scan the QR code to join. Up to 8 players, each with their own ball color.

Players: flick up on your phone to shoot. Flick direction aims, flick speed is power. One flick, one ball.

Scoring: still baskets are worth 2 points, moving baskets 3 points. 90 seconds, unlimited balls — most points when the clock hits zero wins. Tied at the top? You share the win.

Bot demo: four bots play a match by themselves — handy as an idle screen, or to see how it runs before the crowd arrives.
